subject: XBox Live Gamercard added
author: Xandu
body:
We did this poll to see what kind of stuff you want added to the user profiles on BurnoutAholics.com.
I've now added the XBox Live Gamercard to your profiles. This gives easy access to the information that is available from xbox.com.

The other features in the poll might be added later.

Feel free to send us feedback about stuff that you think might be cool have on the site. We will probably be doing more polls like this in the future.

-- BurnoutAholics.com admin --
